name: Virginia Tech
header:
Virginia Tech
United States · Mathematics PhD
Roster and rank verification handled separately
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• Adviser outreach is strongly encouraged before application; use the official Research Advisors list.
• The department describes funding as two MS years plus four PhD years, not an undifferentiated six-year
direct-PhD guarantee.
• Your pending UChicago degree may need individual English-waiver review.
• Shortlist prioritizes algebraic/arithmetic geometry and representation theory; applied coding and ergodic
number theory are marked adjacent. Harmonic-analysis faculty are not treated as algebraic-geometry
matches.

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Graduate admission normally requires GPA 3.0, with holistic exceptions. UChicago bachelor’s preparation is
eligible for graduate study, and F-1 applicants can enroll at Blacksburg. Mathematics describes an MS-to-PhD
progression; ask whether your bachelor’s applicant should select PhD or MS en route, because initial
degree-selection instructions were not explicit. [s2] [s3] [s6]
Before submission; Adviser contact [Standing rule]
The department strongly encourages identifying and contacting potential research advisers before applying
and naming interests/faculty in the personal statement. It describes beginning an adviser relationship as
important for competitiveness, but does not publish a signed supervisor-approval prerequisite. Prepare three
letters, transcript uploads and any English waiver documentation; request fee waiver before submitting. [s1]
[s5]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Post-submission email provides tracking instructions. Transcript uploads precede submission;
immigration/financial documentation can follow admission through IntlHokies after VT account creation. Letter
receipt is checked with mathematics. [s3] [s6] [s7]
Cycle verification [Standing rule]
Standing January 1 rules and current 2026-27 salary table; no explicit 2027 mathematics stipend or
date/time-zone confirmation. [s1] [s9]

sections.title: Deadlines by stage
sections.text:
Academic application; Funding consideration [Standing rule]
January 1 for full fall admission and GTA/GRA consideration; standing rule with no year or time zone. Later
applications are accepted with no funding guarantee. Central international outer application date is April 1 and
acceptance must occur by May 15, but these do not replace January 1. [s1] [s23]
Reference receipt; Supporting documents [Standing rule]
Complete the application and supporting materials by January 1 for full consideration. No independent
mathematics reference grace period was found; central policy requires all materials by the departmental
deadline. [s2] [s23]

Test-score receipt [Standing rule]
Required English scores should arrive with the complete January 1 file; allow up to four weeks for official score
matching. ETS institution code 5859, no department code. A separate score grace date is not published. [s4]
[s23]
Accepting an offer [Standing rule]
Graduate School expressly states assistantship recipients need not commit before April 15. This is a standing
institutional statement, not an independently verified Fall 2027 contract; inspect the specific admission/funding
offer for its final response conditions. [s3]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
Current testing page: TOEFL new scale 4.5 overall and each subsection 4.5; earlier iBT 90 overall, each 20;
IELTS 6.5. GTA speaking expectation is new TOEFL 5; 4.5 requires unit justification and below 4.5 Graduate
School justification. Teaching requirements are separate from admission. [s4]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
An awarded degree from an accredited institution with English instruction may waive admission testing after
transcript/degree-conferral and language review. UChicago should meet the institution/language condition, but
the public rule specifies an awarded degree; waiver while your degree is pending is not established. Confirm
separately whether teaching-language assessment remains. [s4]
GRE General; GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Neither General nor Mathematics GRE is required. Department explicitly promises equal consideration to
applications without scores; it does not say scores are forbidden. [s1]

Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Before submission upload a legible front-and-back transcript from each institution where a degree was or will
be earned; do not send records for non-degree-only attendance/community college. PDF or Word .doc, showing
names, courses, grades and grading scale. Official degree-conferral records are required after admission and
before enrollment. [s7]
Mathematics-course list; Course descriptions [Standing rule]
Not listed as a separate required item on the public mathematics application checklist. This does not establish
whether the current portal permits an optional upload; exact prompt, length, formatting and upload/link rule
are not published. [s1] [s3]

sections.title: Recommendation letters
sections.text:
Number and type [Standing rule]
Three letters, preferably upper-level mathematics instructors or research mentors; writers should address
mathematical synthesis and graduate research potential. Electronic email contacts or paper letters directly to
the department are supported. [s1] [s3]
Scholarship references [Unresolved]
Departmental assistantship consideration accompanies the January 1 application; no separate initial GTA
essay/reference is published. Central fellowships mostly require departmental nomination with award-specific
rules. Extra references/prompts/deadlines for Fall 2027 awards remain unverified. [s1] [s22]
What sends the invitation; Before versus after submission [Unresolved]
The public instructions say to enter referees’ email addresses but do not specify whether saving them sends

invitations immediately or submission is required. Confirm the trigger in the portal before notifying referees of
a send date. [s3]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
Central FAQ directs applicants to the department to verify recommendation receipt; the central tracking
checklist documents tests/transcripts, not an explicit individual letter-receipt confirmation. [s6]
Updating and reusing letters [Unresolved]
Denied applications are held for one year and departmental reconsideration can include new letters. This does
not establish ordinary portal replacement of received letters or reuse across programs/cycles; ask the
department. [s6]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Prior cycle]
Mathematics pays a nine-month GTA stipend plus tuition waiver but does not publish its exact step. University
2026-27 ordinary full-time Step 1 minimum is $2,909/month, $26,181 for nine months; this is a floor, not a
math offer. Rates include a $665 monthly academic-year supplement intended to offset comprehensive fees.
Step 0 requires supplemental fellowship bringing total above Step 1. Fall 2027 amount remains unverified. [s2]
[s9]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Normally two years of MS GTA support and four years after PhD admission with satisfactory progress; further
support needs Graduate Program Committee permission. Summer GTA awards are competitive; research
grants may provide summer funds. Confirm how this framework applies to direct PhD admission. [s2] [s24]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
The program welcomes international students and describes funding for all admitted graduate students;
assistantship employment eligibility and English teaching assessment apply. This supports international
assistantship consideration, not eligibility for every named fellowship. [s2] [s8]

Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Full assistantship normally means 20 hours/week, full-time enrollment 12-18 credits, GPA 3.0 and satisfactory
progress. In-state tuition is proportionally remitted and out-of-state tuition waived if earnings criteria are met.
Health subsidy is conditional; comprehensive/CFE fees are not directly paid under standard policy despite the
stipend supplement. Summer tuition is not part of ordinary fall/spring remission. [s8] [s9]
Extra funding application [Unresolved]
Departmental assistantship consideration accompanies the January 1 application; no separate initial GTA
essay/reference is published. Central fellowships mostly require departmental nomination with award-specific
rules. Extra references/prompts/deadlines for Fall 2027 awards remain unverified. [s1] [s22]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Ling award for mathematics PhD students is selected each September for research, about $700 varying with
funds, with no application. Central awards explicitly mark those open to international students; Spring 2027
Powell is US citizen/permanent resident only and is not your Fall 2027 route. Faculty grants can support
research/summer work. [s2] [s21] [s22]
Application fee [Standing rule]
US $75 nonrefundable. [s3] [s5]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Apply through Fee Waiver Request tab before submission; allow 5-7 business days and wait for approval.
Eligible affiliations include Math Alliance, NSF/NIH REU, Fulbright and specified service programs with
documentation; financial need alone is not accepted centrally. One single-use code per qualifying reason; no
refunds. Mathematics generally has no waiver but may consider an adviser-requested special circumstance.
[s1] [s5]

sections.text:
Algebraic / arithmetic geometry
Leo Herr
Logarithmic geometry, tropical methods, Gromov-Witten theory, quantum K-theory, deformation theory and
rational-point lifting. [s10] [s11]
Listed on official departmental faculty pages; availability to supervise new PhD students is not published.
Research evidence: 2026 preprint · Splitting and loop theorems in logarithmic Gromov-Witten theory
Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.
Leonardo Mihalcea
Schubert calculus, quantum K-theory of flag varieties, characteristic classes and geometric representation
theory. [s10] [s12]

Listed on official departmental faculty pages; availability to supervise new PhD students is not published.

Recent research evidence; verify supervision availability separately.

recovery. [s10] [s16]

text:
Virginia Tech
United States · Mathematics PhD
Roster and rank verification handled separately
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• Adviser outreach is strongly encouraged before application; use the official Research Advisors list.
• The department describes funding as two MS years plus four PhD years, not an undifferentiated six-year
direct-PhD guarantee.
• Your pending UChicago degree may need individual English-waiver review.
• Shortlist prioritizes algebraic/arithmetic geometry and representation theory; applied coding and ergodic
number theory are marked adjacent. Harmonic-analysis faculty are not treated as algebraic-geometry
matches.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Graduate admission normally requires GPA 3.0, with holistic exceptions. UChicago bachelor’s preparation is
eligible for graduate study, and F-1 applicants can enroll at Blacksburg. Mathematics describes an MS-to-PhD
progression; ask whether your bachelor’s applicant should select PhD or MS en route, because initial
degree-selection instructions were not explicit. [s2] [s3] [s6]
Before submission; Adviser contact [Standing rule]
The department strongly encourages identifying and contacting potential research advisers before applying
and naming interests/faculty in the personal statement. It describes beginning an adviser relationship as
important for competitiveness, but does not publish a signed supervisor-approval prerequisite. Prepare three
letters, transcript uploads and any English waiver documentation; request fee waiver before submitting. [s1]
[s5]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Post-submission email provides tracking instructions. Transcript uploads precede submission;
immigration/financial documentation can follow admission through IntlHokies after VT account creation. Letter
receipt is checked with mathematics. [s3] [s6] [s7]
Cycle verification [Standing rule]
Standing January 1 rules and current 2026-27 salary table; no explicit 2027 mathematics stipend or
date/time-zone confirmation. [s1] [s9]
Deadlines by stage
Academic application; Funding consideration [Standing rule]
January 1 for full fall admission and GTA/GRA consideration; standing rule with no year or time zone. Later
applications are accepted with no funding guarantee. Central international outer application date is April 1 and
acceptance must occur by May 15, but these do not replace January 1. [s1] [s23]
Reference receipt; Supporting documents [Standing rule]
Complete the application and supporting materials by January 1 for full consideration. No independent
mathematics reference grace period was found; central policy requires all materials by the departmental
deadline. [s2] [s23]

Test-score receipt [Standing rule]
Required English scores should arrive with the complete January 1 file; allow up to four weeks for official score
matching. ETS institution code 5859, no department code. A separate score grace date is not published. [s4]
[s23]
Accepting an offer [Standing rule]
Graduate School expressly states assistantship recipients need not commit before April 15. This is a standing
institutional statement, not an independently verified Fall 2027 contract; inspect the specific admission/funding
offer for its final response conditions. [s3]
English and GRE
English requirement [Standing rule]
Current testing page: TOEFL new scale 4.5 overall and each subsection 4.5; earlier iBT 90 overall, each 20;
IELTS 6.5. GTA speaking expectation is new TOEFL 5; 4.5 requires unit justification and below 4.5 Graduate
School justification. Teaching requirements are separate from admission. [s4]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
An awarded degree from an accredited institution with English instruction may waive admission testing after
transcript/degree-conferral and language review. UChicago should meet the institution/language condition, but
the public rule specifies an awarded degree; waiver while your degree is pending is not established. Confirm
separately whether teaching-language assessment remains. [s4]
GRE General; GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Neither General nor Mathematics GRE is required. Department explicitly promises equal consideration to
applications without scores; it does not say scores are forbidden. [s1]
Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Before submission upload a legible front-and-back transcript from each institution where a degree was or will
be earned; do not send records for non-degree-only attendance/community college. PDF or Word .doc, showing
names, courses, grades and grading scale. Official degree-conferral records are required after admission and
before enrollment. [s7]
Mathematics-course list; Course descriptions [Standing rule]
Not listed as a separate required item on the public mathematics application checklist. This does not establish
whether the current portal permits an optional upload; exact prompt, length, formatting and upload/link rule
are not published. [s1] [s3]
Recommendation letters
Number and type [Standing rule]
Three letters, preferably upper-level mathematics instructors or research mentors; writers should address
mathematical synthesis and graduate research potential. Electronic email contacts or paper letters directly to
the department are supported. [s1] [s3]
Scholarship references [Unresolved]
Departmental assistantship consideration accompanies the January 1 application; no separate initial GTA
essay/reference is published. Central fellowships mostly require departmental nomination with award-specific
rules. Extra references/prompts/deadlines for Fall 2027 awards remain unverified. [s1] [s22]
What sends the invitation; Before versus after submission [Unresolved]
The public instructions say to enter referees’ email addresses but do not specify whether saving them sends

invitations immediately or submission is required. Confirm the trigger in the portal before notifying referees of
a send date. [s3]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
Central FAQ directs applicants to the department to verify recommendation receipt; the central tracking
checklist documents tests/transcripts, not an explicit individual letter-receipt confirmation. [s6]
Updating and reusing letters [Unresolved]
Denied applications are held for one year and departmental reconsideration can include new letters. This does
not establish ordinary portal replacement of received letters or reuse across programs/cycles; ask the
department. [s6]
Written materials
Academic CV / resume [Unresolved]
CV/résumé required-versus-optional status and length/format are not specified on the public mathematics
checklist or central how-to-apply page. Check the current portal rather than importing another department’s
résumé requirement. [s1] [s3]
Statement of purpose; Personal / background statement; Research-interest statement [Standing
rule]
Personal statement is expected. Faithful paraphrase of mathematics supplement: discuss research areas you
might explore and faculty who could mentor you, if identified. No separate research statement is established.
Public mathematics instructions do not give exact full portal prompt, page/word limit, formatting or upload/link
specification. [s1]
Research proposal; Writing sample / thesis / research summary; Publications list; Course-list
document; Other short answers / materials [Standing rule]
Not listed as a separate required item on the public mathematics application checklist. This does not establish
whether the current portal permits an optional upload; exact prompt, length, formatting and upload/link rule
are not published. [s1] [s3]
Scholarship essays [Unresolved]
Departmental assistantship consideration accompanies the January 1 application; no separate initial GTA
essay/reference is published. Central fellowships mostly require departmental nomination with award-specific
rules. Extra references/prompts/deadlines for Fall 2027 awards remain unverified. [s1] [s22]
Funding and fees
Amount and coverage [Prior cycle]
Mathematics pays a nine-month GTA stipend plus tuition waiver but does not publish its exact step. University
2026-27 ordinary full-time Step 1 minimum is $2,909/month, $26,181 for nine months; this is a floor, not a
math offer. Rates include a $665 monthly academic-year supplement intended to offset comprehensive fees.
Step 0 requires supplemental fellowship bringing total above Step 1. Fall 2027 amount remains unverified. [s2]
[s9]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Normally two years of MS GTA support and four years after PhD admission with satisfactory progress; further
support needs Graduate Program Committee permission. Summer GTA awards are competitive; research
grants may provide summer funds. Confirm how this framework applies to direct PhD admission. [s2] [s24]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
The program welcomes international students and describes funding for all admitted graduate students;
assistantship employment eligibility and English teaching assessment apply. This supports international
assistantship consideration, not eligibility for every named fellowship. [s2] [s8]

Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Full assistantship normally means 20 hours/week, full-time enrollment 12-18 credits, GPA 3.0 and satisfactory
progress. In-state tuition is proportionally remitted and out-of-state tuition waived if earnings criteria are met.
Health subsidy is conditional; comprehensive/CFE fees are not directly paid under standard policy despite the
stipend supplement. Summer tuition is not part of ordinary fall/spring remission. [s8] [s9]
Extra funding application [Unresolved]
Departmental assistantship consideration accompanies the January 1 application; no separate initial GTA
essay/reference is published. Central fellowships mostly require departmental nomination with award-specific
rules. Extra references/prompts/deadlines for Fall 2027 awards remain unverified. [s1] [s22]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Ling award for mathematics PhD students is selected each September for research, about $700 varying with
funds, with no application. Central awards explicitly mark those open to international students; Spring 2027
Powell is US citizen/permanent resident only and is not your Fall 2027 route. Faculty grants can support
research/summer work. [s2] [s21] [s22]
Application fee [Standing rule]
US $75 nonrefundable. [s3] [s5]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Apply through Fee Waiver Request tab before submission; allow 5-7 business days and wait for approval.
Eligible affiliations include Math Alliance, NSF/NIH REU, Fulbright and specified service programs with
documentation; financial need alone is not accepted centrally. One single-use code per qualifying reason; no
refunds. Mathematics generally has no waiver but may consider an adviser-requested special circumstance.
[s1] [s5]
Conflicts and remaining checks
Conflicting sources [Conflict]
Older general FAQ and department prose use older TOEFL values and broadly say international applicants
submit tests; current testing page provides degree waivers and new-scale thresholds. Apply current central
policy, with pending-degree and GTA review confirmed. [s2] [s4] [s6]
Checks still needed [Unresolved]
Confirm bachelor’s application degree selection, Fall 2027 date/time zone, statement/CV portal prompts,
pending-degree English waiver, exact stipend step and health/fee balance, referee invitation/update/reuse and
individual fellowship nominations. [s1] [s2] [s4] [s6]
